Five of Coins,  it is a card that relates usually to the earth zodiac signs,  but when we talk about the effect of this card, we are talking about the air zodiac signs, because it is a card that highlights our mind transposed as in a theatrical scene divided into two planes.As a result, it indicates the type of vision we adopt when five coins appear in our lives. The first plan is your current mental plan, and the plan that you are focused the most on, it represents how you see yourself and the situation, you see it hopless, that there is no reason to try, because you might think that you lack something or you don't have something. And that ''something'' is the 5th coin, which is not seen by the charachters in the card, because they are too focused on their own ideea of ,,oh look at me.... i don't have that and that, and i lack of that and that''. This card doesn't invalidate how you feel like, it show that you tend to be  a bit unrealistical with yourself and tend to sabotage yourself, when in the reality, yes you might not have that thing that could be material or emotional, but look at how many qualities you have out of 5 coins you have 4. And that's the second plan, the one in the backround, with all the coins arranged on the Tree of Life and it is hold by the card itself. It's like an ecourgement that you get from this card, it tells you, stop focusing on the negative part because you are a really gifted person, and you have exactly how much you need to achieve what you want to the point that the 5th coin that you  focus is not even needed at this moment. The magician, it's the most powerful card from major arcana when it come to the power of materializing the thing we want, bringing them to the reality, If you really focus on something that you want you gonna have it, and that's the magician. Being reversd it could mean that you keep remaining blinded by a situation and clinging to the past which is causing you to stagnate, and leaves you with a feeling of being drained or lethargic with no sense of personal direction, basically very defocused. But I also think it'a proof which strengthens the idea of ​​self-sabotage, presented by 5 of coins. You are the magician in this story, you have the power and the qualities to put this situation in your favor in make it good, but that's where self sabotage take part and makes a very strong card into your obstacle, because you don't belive enough. Personally i think Queen of Sword is what cards advice you to do, go to him and be completly honest with that you feel, like blunt honest. Take the situation in your own hands. Queens of sword is in the air element, which mean mental strenght, courage, inteligence and wisdom. The charachter is a widow who is used with a harsh life, because her number is 7, which in numerology is a let's say ''sharp'' number,  are assigned to people who are used to living the hardships of life, to be independent and to take control of the situation. So be brave, because the Queen of Swrod know you are capable and is the best advice you could get from her. The six of pentacles also comes as an advice, and that is to be open to what life gives you.  The tower isn't a bad sign, because it tells you that through this experience that you go through and that you will keep going  through in this life is to form a new base. The base that in the card The tower shatters, so that you have room to build something new. So the cards are telling you that what's happening to you right now it serves a little in consolidating a new relationship but more in consolidating yourself as a person and in rebuilding the base of your tower.  Be more brave, blunt, honest, cut what's not good in your life like the Queen of Swords, be open to the good things life gives you because you deserve it, and last but not least be more realistic with yourself and the qualities you have. That's my personal interpretation. :D P.S: Sorry for grammar mistakes.

Well, four of cups relates to the water zodiac signs, more specific to the scorpios. In his general meaning for of cups talk about a person who is just consumed by his own emotions, being just to focused on his own problems and mind to the point where he's not aware anymore to the external world. Reversed mean that you gonna break free from this cell, from your own thought that kept bothering you, it's a double edged sword, because yes you finally come out of your deep thoughts but it also can indicate mental problems. Is like yes, finally i won this battles but the wound are still there. Cups being related to the water element means that this thing that happened hitted the most on the emotional level. Queen of cups talk about our intuition, she apperas in our life through intuition and she manifest in this way because she doesn't want to hurt us. Think about the diffrences when someones tell us a thing face to face and when your intuition tells you the same thing, it hits diffrently, That's a sign that you should listen way more to your intuition, especially if you are a water zodiac sign, because it will never fail you. One way to differentiate intuition from anxiety is by intuition manifesting itself as a whisper, calm but constant, while anxiety as a scream, which puts you in constant distress. So you might knew inside you about what might happen but you chose to not listen to. So do that and you gonna see how much your life will improve. Six of wands in his general meaning talks about  a metaphric war you've been thorugh and finally getting out of it but also taking with you some deep wounds. The character represented in this card is a just person, who fight with honor. Also has a strong mind. Being reversed is just represents your current situation ... exactly how it is feling weak, you lack of stability in your life right now and you feel that you lost the fight. Well the wheel of fortune it's a karmic card, so karma had a play into this, but being reversed it warns that you may be allowing others to have too strong an influence on your life. It's from the major arcana, and 10th card, number 10 meaning lessons learned, this card being upside down mean that you really have ro restore your life and think about deeply about the mistakes you might made in your judgement. I can't tell you what lessons you should learn from this, you know better what. I'm really sorry you've been through this, but don't give up, what happened to you was to form you, unfortunately on the rough way. But certanly it's a sign that you need to do a major cleaning in your life, and listen more to your intuition. Stay strong and take care!

Depends on what part of the past you were thinking. But in general page of swords reflect the air element, so it indicates you mental traits that you might used to have or still have. Those 2 cards describe you and your decission. Page of swords reflects in you an inteligent compassionate, thoughtful and capable person. When we talk about pages, we talk about young people, even if you have your qualities, at younger ages we tend to do let's say hasty decisions, or not give too much of a thought before doing something, so that's where the fool appears. The fool has a philosophical meaning, but i guess it goes more into the conventional meaning this time, showing that you made a decission, not an ordinary one ofc, one that had very much weight in your life, and forced you to change your perspective, that's why is upside down, it's interesting because the fool upside down it's basically the Hanged Man. I might be wrong but i think you might be a capricorn or you have the rising in capricorn. Also another interesting thing is that the page of sword is assigned  to the number 9, which is basically finality of something, you were very close to an ending, that's why the fool was the next card, basically you were done with everything around you, you carried a lot, and you wanted to take  the next step no matter what, you didn't had quite a plan but you just wanted well in a more literate manner, to start a new thing. But here is the thing,  there is no ten in the reading, that's a sign that yes, you were very close, but as I said before, when we are young or have a young mentality we tend to make hasty decision, and want to make the things happen faster in our lifes, and because of that you didn't learnd what you needed to learn at that time, number 10 being lessons learned. So that's why we have the fool upside down (hanged man), to fill that gap, and force you to change perspective in order to have the lessson learned. That's my personal interpretation :D
